app.loading: Shown while the app starts. Short.
app.loadingEditor: Shown while the code editor loads.
app.backToLanding: Accessible label of the logo link that leads back to the product page.
app.requestSection: Name of the main area where a request is edited. Used for screen readers.
app.window.minimize: Title bar button of the desktop app window.
app.window.maximize: Title bar button of the desktop app window.
app.window.restore: Title bar button that returns a maximized window to its normal size.
app.crash.description: {{error}} is the technical error text and stays as it is. The blank line before it is part of the message.
app.loadFailure.description: {{reason}} is a sentence explaining what went wrong, already in the interface language.
app.labelled: Pattern for an accessible label: what the button does, a colon, then the name of the item it acts on. For example "Pin: Local files".
